requirement:
Create `app/validators.py` with `parse_date_range(start: str, end: str) -> tuple[date, date]` (`datetime.date`). Both arguments are ISO calendar dates `YYYY-MM-DD` (surrounding whitespace is ignored). Raise `ValueError` if either is not a real calendar date (e.g. `2023-02-30`, `2023-13-01`, `23-01-01`, `2023-1-1`) or if `end` is before `start`. `start == end` is allowed. Also provide `days_inclusive(start: str, end: str) -> int` returning the number of days in the range counting both ends (same day -> 1). Leap years must be handled correctly.
The project must also contain `app/main.py` defining a FastAPI `app` (entry point `app.main:app`) (no endpoints required) and `app/__init__.py`. Include unit tests (pytest).
acceptance_criteria: Only real ISO calendar dates are accepted
end before start is rejected; equal dates allowed
Inclusive day count is correct across leap years
